title: refactor: remove hogan.js
body:
**Summary**

[FX-3031](https://algolia.atlassian.net/browse/FX-3031)

**Result**

- Templates should be functions or strings. Functions returning simple strings and simple strings directly work, if it returns a string with HTML tags these will be escaped by Preact.
  - Updated all default templates and tests accordingly.
- Took the opportunity to remove `bindEvent` as it was linked to templates.
- Still kept the `Template` component as templates are not valid components, they take 2 arguments.
- Removed hogan dependencies

[FX-3031]: https://algolia.atlassian.net/browse/FX-3031?atlOrigin=eyJpIjoiNWRkNTljNzYxNjVmNDY3MDlhMDU5Y2ZhYzA5YTRkZjUiLCJwIjoiZ2l0aHViLWNvbS1KU1cifQ
